title: Failure Heatmap & Payload Drillflow — wireframes and interaction spec
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: On-call engineers and platform SREs need a fast way to understand where failures concentrate and quickly pivot from aggregate signals to the exact payload that triggered a user-facing error. Current Console views surface lists and traces but lack a visual aggregation that highlights hotspots over time and an efficient, low-friction path to inspect full request payloads and retry metadata.

Goal: Design a compact "Failure Heatmap" dashboard panel plus an inline "Payload Drillflow" that lets users: 1) spot hotspot windows (time ranges + endpoints/models) at a glance, 2) filter by error taxonomy and retry state, 3) open a compact payload inspector (with redaction helpers) and quick-replay controls, and 4) surface automated retry suggestions and root-cause hints from correlated signal (e.g., increased tokenization errors after recent model rollout).

Proposed screens and interactions (wireframes attached):
- Failure Heatmap (compact card): 24h/7d/30d toggle, vertical axis = endpoint/model, horizontal axis = time buckets, color intensity = failure rate or retry-weighted failure score. Hover shows bucket summary with top error classes and example sample ids. Click bucket opens Payload Drillflow for that endpoint+bucket.
- Payload Drillflow (side sheet): stacked timeline of matching requests (most recent first) with quick-filters (status, retry_count, error_class). Each list row: timestamp, request id, short message, badges (retry, cached, fallback-model). Expanding a row shows full payload inspector with collapsible sections for headers, body, cached keys, KV cache snapshot.
- Compact Payload Inspector: copy-to-clipboard, redact-button (suggested fields to mask: auth tokens, credit-card-like strings, embeddings), link-to-full-request (for deep forensic tooling), and "Quick Replay" with editable prompt and a selected model variant dropdown. Replay includes delta-comparison view of responses side-by-side.
- Automated Suggestions rail: shows probable root causes (highly correlated changes) like recent rollout, quantization mismatch, or input distribution drift. Suggestions include one-click actions (re-run against older model variant, mark bucket as "investigating").

Trade-offs & notes:
- Heatmap aggregation reduces noise but can hide low-frequency critical failures — add a "highlight rare-but-severe" toggle.
- Payload storage and redaction: default UI should never surface unredacted secrets; engineering must ensure the inspector uses redaction heuristics and can only show unredacted content to users with proper audit flags.
- Performance: initial wireframes use client-side rendering for heatmap; if buckets exceed thresholds, switch to server-rendered bitmap tiles.

Metrics to validate success: reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) for top 3 classes by 20% in pilot customers, decrease in paging for false-positives, time-on-boarding for new SREs reduced when using heatmap on first incident.

Artifacts: Figma prototype + interaction spec links in mockups field below.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap card implemented in Console storybook with 24h/7d/30d toggles and click-to-open behavior
Payload Drillflow side sheet design documented with all inspector states (compact, expanded, redacted) and interactions covered
Copy/Redact/Quick Replay controls included in the mockups and annotated with expected analytics events
Security constraints documented for engineers: redaction heuristics, audit flags required for unredacted view
Usability test with 5 SREs shows at least 80% can locate a failed payload and initiate a replay within 90 seconds
review_notes: PM (Lena Park): please include a clear signal for 'fallback model used' — that's critical for customer-facing incidents.
Eng (Samir Patel): backend needs an API to return pre-aggregated buckets and a tile endpoint; flagged dependency ENG-2478.
Security (Priya Nair): ensure redact-button is a demo-only hint; unredacted content requires KMS audit and role-check — blocking for private deployments without audit logs.
next_steps: Sync with ENG-2478 owner to align API contract and performance expectations
Prototype clickable heatmap tile in Storybook and validate with 3 internal incidents
Run a short hallway usability session with 5 target users and iterate on the Drillflow row affordances
usability_test_plan: Recruit 5 internal SREs and 5 product engineers. Tasks: locate the highest failure hotspot in a 24h view, open payload drillflow, identify the top error class, and perform a quick replay. Measure task completion time, error rate, and subjective SUS score. Capture video and transcribe key friction points.
